about: Zorra is a township in Oxford County, Ontario, surrounding countryside west and north of the separate City of Woodstock—not Woodstock itself. Villages such as Embro, Thamesford, and Harrington sit among livestock and field-crop farms. About 9,000 people live in Zorra Township.
seoSummary: Oxford County township of Embro, Thamesford, and Harrington—farm country around Woodstock, not the city.
